# Codex app-server 0.167.2 schema capture

Generated on 2026-11-13 without a native session or model turn from the installed macOS arm64 binary `/opt/homebrew/Caskroom/codex/0.167.2/bin/codex`. `codex --version` and `codex app-server generate-json-schema --out <temporary>` both exited 0. Its SHA256 before and after generation was `97bc82fd46f117cf10efb95e6ff0c81dc4784f5797bcdc2cb75093ba09e4def0`. `capture-provenance.json` records the executable, exact argv, command outputs, times and complete 322-file raw inventory. `contract-provenance.json` records the 52 consumed schemas retained here. The consumed extraction command was `node scripts/generate-codex-schema-contract.mjs /private/tmp/pb417-contract-20261113/raw test/fixtures/codex-app-server/0.167.2 0.167.2` (exit 0).

Compared with [0.166.0](../0.166.0/README.md), 15 consumed documents change. `CommandExecutionApprovalKind` changes from `enum: [command, writeStdin]` to `oneOf` with that same string enum and a second string arm containing only `humanCommand`. This definition appears in `CommandExecutionRequestApprovalParams` and `ServerRequest`. `InitializeCapabilities` adds optional boolean `requiredHumanApproval` in `ClientRequest` and `v1/InitializeParams`. `UserInput.audio` permits a string `fileId` or string `url` (or both), instead of requiring `url`; its definition changes in `ClientRequest`, `ServerNotification`, `v2/ReviewStartResponse`, `v2/ThreadListResponse`, `v2/ThreadReadResponse`, `v2/ThreadResumeResponse`, `v2/ThreadStartResponse`, `v2/TurnCompletedNotification`, `v2/TurnStartParams`, `v2/TurnStartResponse`, `v2/TurnStartedNotification` and `v2/TurnSteerParams`. No consumed response-decision or server-method inventory changes.

The [upstream README](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/ce21072c90d32c40af7a55b60b2fb35c84a43a6a/codex-rs/app-server/README.md#managed-human-command-checkpoints-experimental) at tag `rust-v0.167.2` (annotated tag `08a3b12b3298577534a28b62ed976acf8de66eda`, commit `ce21072c90d32c40af7a55b60b2fb35c84a43a6a`) defines `humanCommand` as a managed checkpoint needing a fresh human decision. Session and persistent approvals cannot satisfy it. Both `experimentalApi` and `requiredHumanApproval` are required; only `accept`, `decline` and `cancel` are valid replies. With no capable connection the command is rejected. The checkpoint itself starts no execution item. The [initialize processor](https://github.com/openai/codex/blob/ce21072c90d32c40af7a55b60b2fb35c84a43a6a/codex-rs/app-server/src/request_processors/initialize_processor.rs#L144-L148) enables the connection only with both flags. Source blob identities and hashes are recorded in capture provenance; this documents source semantics, not a native execution measurement.

The holder does not advertise `requiredHumanApproval`. It refuses `humanCommand` and unknown or malformed explicit kinds before network, containment or role dispatch, sending only `decline`. Omitted `kind` keeps the legacy `command` default; `command` and `writeStdin` retain network, containment, additional-root and reviewer restrictions. The audio schema extension adds no runtime input feature. Finite witnesses cover both kind-schema locations, historical enums, capability booleans and malformed values, audio alternatives, non-advertisement and runtime refusals.

Native evidence is version-scoped. The [0.164.0 record](../0.164.0/README.md) keeps its worker, reviewer, approver and hook measurements; the [0.159.2 record](../0.159.2/README.md) keeps its own live evidence. The [0.166.0 capture](../0.166.0/README.md) remains historical. None is relabelled as 0.167.2 proof. Selected-profile ordinary workflow qualification and available-subscription measurements on 0.167.2 remain unmeasured. Exact source/schema matching does not certify runtime workflows.
